do: Verify the identity card of the visiting enumerator.
Answer census-related demographic and housing questions accurately.
dont: Do NOT share your bank account details.
Do NOT share any OTPs (One Time Passwords) sent to your phone.
Do NOT share UPI PINs or passwords.

do: Ask to see the official Census Identity Card.
Check official local government announcements regarding census dates in your area.
dont: Do NOT let anyone inside your home if they refuse to show their official ID.
Do NOT pay any money to enumerators. The census is completely free.
